name: tavily
description: Search the web, extract page content, map sites, and crawl domains through Tavily's official remote MCP server.

description.en: Search the web, extract page content, map sites, and crawl domains through Tavily's official remote MCP server.
description.zh-cn: 通过 Tavily 官方远程 MCP 服务搜索网页、提取页面内容、生成站点地图并抓取网站。
description.ja: Tavily 公式リモート MCP サーバーを通じて、ウェブ検索、ページ内容の抽出、サイトマップ作成、サイトクロールを行います。

interface.shortDescription: Search, extract, map, and crawl the web
interface.longDescription: Use Tavily's official remote MCP server to perform real-time web searches, extract clean content from URLs, map website structure, and crawl domains for research and analysis.
defaultPrompt: Search the web for current information about a topic.
Extract the main content from a webpage.
Map or crawl a website to find relevant pages.
